market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC is at ~$78,060 and needs to drop 36% to $50,000 by December 31. With 8 months of runway, this is more plausible than the $45k level. Historical BTC cycles have seen 40-60% corrections even within bull markets. The Iran war and global macro uncertainty add tail risk. CoinDesk notes BTC on track for best month in a year, suggesting current bullish momentum but long-duration bear risk remains non-trivial.
data_sources: Historical BTC drawdown analysis (2021-2022 cycle: 75% peak-to-trough)
assessment.key_uncertainty: 8-month window and global macro trajectory; requires sustained bear market pressure from current levels
